profile.headline: Software Developer at StoneX Group Inc.
profile.summary: I have 6 years of software engineering experience. I drive software improvements and implementations by translating customer requirements into practical code. Using a mix of Agile and Extreme Programming, I lead teammates during code reviews, scrum meetings, and demonstrations. I identify risks and design solutions to help mitigate the risk. I mentored new hires by teaching them how to debug, test code, and document code changes. I instruct engineers and configuration managers on how to use Mercurial or GIT. Using excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, I found opportunities to streamline processes and implement change.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I am a Full Stack Developer
I write back-end code in C sharp and SQL
I write front-end in javascript, ReactJs and css

* Created new documentation library
* Created Azure loggers

positions.title: Electronics Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created innovations to increase speed and compliance while decreasing inefficiencies, effort, and time.
 	** Experimented with new technologies to provide better tools for increasing efficiency by 10%
 	** Created and documented new software development processes to reduce overhead cost by 5%
        ** Developed new in-house language pre-processor tools to reduce code maintenance effort by 40%
        ** Started up Mercurial and GIT version control systems for multiple teams; to reduce overhead cost by 5%
•	Prepared, Revised, and Released code for Major and Minor Version Releases
        ** Translated 10,000+ lines of source code into 600+ page documents for individual functionalities
        ** Coordinated team tasks between different skill levels to reduce schedule slip and re-work by 25%
        ** Certified 100+ source code modules meet Government regulations and Customer requirements
        ** Created VBA and SQL automaton tools to reduce costs by 66% and increase speed by 800%
        ** Updated software requirements documentation and 10% of all requirements (missing or errors)
        ** Created simple and effective data flow diagrams, decision trees, and requirement documents
•	Rehosted legacy source code from obsolete platforms to continue supporting customers
        ** Collaborated with Subject Matter Experts and stakeholders to document existing and proposed requirements
        ** Planned and prepared team resources to setup the workstation at the customer worksite
        ** Demonstrated to customer satisfaction both full regression functionality and new features
        ** Rehosted previous platform tools and resources with step-by-step instructions
•	Facilitated communication between co-workers, company employees and customers
        ** Worked with individuals and stakeholders to define requirements to create user stories for the agile process
        ** Communicated with the customer to find the source of confusion and solved the situation

positions.title: Business Intelligence Developer
positions.description:
●	Coordinated and communicated with team members and cross-applications to correctly store patient information 
●	Ran quality control discussions amongst team members to create and maintain project standards
●	Developed and upgraded tools for Analysts to gather patient information for their organization’s metrics
●	Understood customer work flows to better develop the Company product for customer needs
●	Used proprietary language to increase software quality by finding and fixing bugs in code 
●	Wrote and reviewed designs for software enhancements
●	Wrote Customer Facing documentation to explain the benefits of a new update
●	Created Unit Tests to automatically check the impact, of future code changes, on original functionality
●	Developed code to make the transfer of patient information to be vendor agnostic

positions.title: Co-op: Engineering Aide
positions.description:
I worked at Polytron for 3 separate rotational semesters: 
1. August 2011 - December 2011
2. May 2012 - August 2012
3. Jan 2013 - May 2013

As an Engineering Aide, I:
●	Created/Edited control automaton CAD drawings for the engineers to present for bid/approval from senior employees
●	Conducted initial review of printed CAD drawings/documents for review and for shipment to clients 
●	Set up and re-calibrated Schneider Electric motors to be reviewed and sent to client 
●	Documented new procedures for design group and contributed to a training manual for client 
●	Organized asset inventories to facilitate borrowing and using of inventory equipment 
●	Presented project reports to supervisor and team members 
●	Contributed to training and mentoring new co-ops in Polytron

projects.title: GTMRS
projects.description: Created the MySQL backend for a Java based application which simulated a working medical records system. The system was implemented using a relational database management system that supported standard SQL queries.

organizations.name: Eta Kappa Nu
organizations.position: Webmaster, Assistant Corresponding Secretary,Picnic Enter/Publicity Chair · Jan 2012 - May 2014
organizations.description: I initiated new members into the organization to make sure that the organization will keep growing. I updated and maintained the HKN webpage. I ran a lab tool packaging session so that fellow students could have more affordable learning resources. I set-up the ECE Spring Picnic and scheduled necessary resources for students to socialize with ECE Professors and Staff.
